name: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with chicken breast, pineapple, and vegetables, served over hot rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped onion, diced celery, green pepper strips, and pineapple chunks in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together cornstarch, reserved pineapple juice, cinnamon, and soya sauce.
In a skillet over high heat, add margarine and cook chicken strips for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet, stir well, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until the sauce is clear and thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over hot rice.

keywords: chicken stir-fry, pineapple chicken, quick dinner

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Beef
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Turkey A La King
_similar.description: A creamy turkey dish made with mushrooms, celery, and green pepper, served over toast or rice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, celery, and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, blend flour into the butter to make a roux. Gradually add chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Add reserved turkey and vegetables to the sauce. Heat through.
Serve over hot toast, biscuits, or rice.

_similar.keywords: turkey a la king, creamy turkey, mushrooms, celery, green pepper

_similar.name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
_similar.description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
_similar.recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: turkey pie, chicken pie, savory pastry, comfort food

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty meatball dish smothered in a rich sweet and sour pineapple sauce, baked to perfection.
recipeIngredient: For the sauce: ½ cup brown sugar, ½ cup vinegar, 19 oz pineapple tidbits (undrained), ½ tsp salt, 1 Tbsp cornstarch

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together ground beef, onion, cracker crumbs, garlic, pepper, egg, and milk. Chill until firm.
Shape into evenly sized meatballs and place on a greased broiler pan.
Broil to brown on all sides, watching carefully.
Place meatballs in a casserole dish.
To make the sauce, combine brown sugar, salt, and cornstarch. Gradually stir in vinegar and soya sauce. Add pineapple tidbits and bring to a boil until thickened and clear.
Pour the sauce over the meatballs and bake in the oven at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour meatballs, baked meatballs, pineapple sauce

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple with Chicken and Ginger
_similar.description: A classic sweet and sour dish featuring parboiled chicken legs in a tangy pineapple and ginger sauce, served over fried rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and separate chicken legs at the joint. Parboil for 15 to 20 minutes to remove excess fat.
Saute onions and celery in vegetable oil until tender. Add drained mushrooms and cook briefly.
Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in hot water. Add soya sauce, ginger, salt, sugar, and vinegar. Bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch with cold water until smooth. Pour into boiling sauce and stir frequently until thickened.
Add drained pineapple to the sauce. Adjust seasoning with pineapple juice if desired.
Lay parboiled chicken pieces in a greased casserole dish. Pour sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Serve over Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, ginger sauce
